title: 1.7 How often do you study?
unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people's habits in Spanish.
goal: Ask and say how often you study and work: ¿Con qué frecuencia estudias de noche? Normalmente estudio de noche.
grammar_function: ¿Con qué frecuencia + tú verb? yo and él/ella + frequency word + verb.
speaking_outcome: Ask and say how often you study and work: ¿Con qué frecuencia estudias de noche? Normalmente estudio de noche.
